svg.title: For p ∈Jm the second term is zero. For arbitrary p ∈Em both summands have the required grade and higher-weight difference, so their sum has leading form p. At the zero weight, J(0,0) = 0, since the equation ideal contains no nonzero unit, so this construction sends the unit to (1, 1). The whole lift is the finite sum F(p) = P m Fm(pm) over the homogeneous components of p. The equation ideal is preserved by taking these components, so its entire image has the marking property. This proves the linear assembly used in the triangular argument.
